title: Onboarding play
idea: Onboarding play: One playable objective teaches an input through immediate feedback
audience: People who need to learn input within a game surface.
avoidWhen: Instructions replace a missing playable system
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic process layout through its learn input priority and explicit commitment contract: Advance only when the actual learned action succeeds
navigation: Onboarding play keeps the current learn input context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: One playable objective teaches an input through immediate feedback
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to learn input; a new mechanic needs practice
composition.priority: Advance only when the actual learned action succeeds

imagery.role: Support the actual learn input context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Adapt prompts to the active input device
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the onboarding play structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no learn input content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Advance only when the actual learned action succeeds
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized learn input content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Advance only when the actual learned action succeeds
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active learn input context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
